outcome: The production workout app presents a distinctive, premium, responsive interface that always makes the next useful action clear while preserving every verified training, nutrition, progress, and coaching workflow.
non_goals: Changing authentication providers, environment credentials, or database schemas
Adding paid design assets or a new UI framework
Keeping synthetic QA food, workout, or body-weight records
constraints: Preserve all user-created data and all previously verified workout behavior
Use the existing React and Next.js stack without new runtime dependencies
Meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast, focus, semantic control, and touch-target expectations
Use one responsive design system from 360px mobile through desktop
Stop after three failed repair hypotheses for one defect and report the blocker

success_checks.command_or_condition: npm test && npm run test:auth && npm run build
Today, Train, Food, Progress, and Coach each render a page-specific hierarchy from production navigation without console or runtime failure.
Production is visually verified at desktop and mobile widths with no clipped content, collapsed panels, horizontal overflow, or unreachable controls.
A workout can start, record a set, show and control rest, advance, save and resume, and discard or finish using clear visible controls.
Food add/remove, Progress logging, and Coach response workflows remain understandable and executable from their redesigned production screens.
The existing Vercel production project is READY at the public URL and verified requests have no failed runtime status codes.

stop_conditions: All required success checks have fresh evidence
A user-only credential or platform action blocks the same check three times
Three repair hypotheses fail for one defect
required_evidence: Fresh unit, auth, and production build output
Desktop and mobile screenshots for all primary pages
In-app browser observations for the workout lifecycle and secondary workflows
Final Vercel deployment and runtime-log evidence
Clean Git worktree and remote main commit
approval_boundaries: Do not expose or modify secrets
Create only clearly temporary QA records and remove them when the UI supports removal
Deploy only to the existing workout-app production project
